This '''sentient species''' was native to the [[H'relac system/Legends|H'relac system]]. They fought to maintain their freedom when an alliance of corporations tried to take control of the system, around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="GC6" />
